The '''garbage proccessing facility''' was a facility for processing garbage at [[Kamino Station X]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]; in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] discovered a document made by the [[Lead Cloning Technician]] in the garbage processing facility.

==Behind the scenes==
The garbage processing facility was mentioned in the [[Dark Apprentice]] Databank entry in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[2010]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.
